title: With no untracked parts, searching not tracked returns no results
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NO UNTRACKED LOC), a location created for this case that holds no untracked part and one tracked part only.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOUNT-01, described ZZAUTOTEST PL PLAIN WASHER) is tracked at {Location-A}, and none of its fields contains "not" or "tracked".
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Type not tracked in the Inventory search.
  2. Read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: No part is listed; the list shows its usual empty search result (for example "No parts match the search "not tracked".").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S6-N1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.4 (Done; the empty search state), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct.
